sources.title: Marshall-Olkin Extended Zipf Distribution
sources.snippet: The Zipf distribution also known as scale-free distribution or discrete Pareto distribution, is the particular case of Power Law distribution with support the strictly positive integers. It is a one-parameter distribution with a linear behaviour in the log-log scale. In this paper the Zipf distribution is generalized by means of the Marshall-Olkin transformation.
